svg.title: T-Block mREDAC Signal-Flow Block Diagram
svg.desc: Block diagram showing digital control above a T-Block routing matrix. Below the T-Block, the backplane and three clusters are aligned in one row. In each cluster, C-Block lanes 0 through 7 connect directly to the I-Block, while lanes 8 through 31 route through the T-Block.

text.tspan: Digital control programs the T-Block; clusters and backplane connect from below

svg.text: routes cluster lanes 8..31 as sector lanes 0..23
24 lanes routed to and from Backplane

text.tspan: *Note : The 24 lanes mentioned are a combined set of 24 lanes, One set of 24 lanes are the inputs and another set of 24 lanes are the outputs
